== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Reading]] is a discipline involving the conscious observation and manipulation of human [[Intent]]. While most people use [[Intent]] subconsciously, [[Readers]] can focus their will to sense the emotions, memories, and histories embedded within physical objects or living beings. This ability allows them to perceive visions of an object's past, sense a person's feelings, or even understand different languages by interpreting the [[Intent]] behind spoken words. The process requires significant focus and emotional empathy; for instance, a lack of sensation can prevent the ability to Read, while attempting to directly examine the [[Intent]] of [[Elders]] can result in insanity. [[Readers]] possess several specialized capabilities. Through [[Active Reading|active Reading]], they can physically alter or transform objects by twisting their [[Intent]], a process similar to [[Awakening]]. This skill is used for crafting tools, creating weapons, investigating crimes, or performing sabotage. While some [[Readers]] focus on the minute details of individual items, others possess immense power, capable of sensing the [[Intent]] of entire cities or vast natural landscapes. Despite their utility, the practice carries risks and limitations. Using these powers can lead to [[Reader burn]], which occurs when a person's abilities exceed their physical constitution. Additionally, mass-produced items often lack the necessary [[Intent]] to be Read effectively. Due to their unique abilities and influence, [[Readers]] often exist outside standard legal constraints, as mortal judges struggle to govern them with impartiality.}}
